description:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building scalable software, cloud systems, and AI-powered applications. I enjoy turning complex problems into practical solutions, especially where AI, space data, and real-world needs intersect.

My experience includes Python, Java, TypeScript, React, GCP, AWS, and Kubernetes, as well as AI agents, RAG systems, computer vision, and large-scale data analysis. I’ve worked with satellite data on projects involving marine conservation
